feedback: My account has been frozen for 9 days and nobody can tell me why. I have rent money stuck in there and support keeps sending me the same copy-paste email.
Account frozen with no explanation: My account was frozen after a routine transfer and I've had no response from the verification team in over a week. I need access to pay my bills.
Locked out of my account with no warning. Passed every verification step and it's still 'under review.' This is my only access to my paycheck.
Faster resolution on account freezes. Mine took over a week and support gave no timeline.
Can't log in after password reset: I reset my password like the email said but now I get 'account locked' every time I try to log in. Please help urgently.
Sending money to family abroad has been smooth and the exchange rate shown upfront is appreciated.
Transfer stuck in pending for days: I sent a payment to a friend on Tuesday and it's still showing pending on my end even though the money already left my bank.
Make it clearer why a transfer is delayed instead of just saying pending with no details.
Sent money to my roommate for rent and it landed in her account in under a minute. So much easier than writing a check.
Unauthorized $600 transaction: There is a transaction I did not make for $600 sent to an account I don't recognize. I want this investigated and reversed immediately.
I'd feel safer if there was two factor authentication required for every new device login, not just sometimes.
Tried to send $400 to my sister and the transfer has been 'pending' for 3 days. Money left my bank account already so now I'm out $400 with nothing to show for it.
Phishing text pretending to be support: I got a text pretending to be your fraud team asking me to verify my card number. Wanted to flag this in case others are getting the same scam.
The verification process to unlock full features asked for way too many documents for a small limit increase.
Someone got into my account and sent themselves $850 from my linked card. I never approved that transaction and now I'm fighting to get it reversed.
Refund not received: The merchant confirmed my refund was issued over a week ago but I still don't see it in my balance or transaction history.
Dispute never resolved after 3 weeks: I opened a dispute for an item that never arrived and it's been open for three weeks with no update. Can someone actually look at this?
Linking my bank account failed twice before finally working on the third try, no idea why.
Got a text that looked exactly like it came from the app asking me to confirm my login. Clicked it and now $200 is gone. Wish the app warned people about these scams more clearly.
I disputed a payment to a seller who never shipped my item. It's been three weeks and the dispute status still just says 'in progress' with zero updates.
ID verification keeps failing: I've submitted my driver's license photo four times now and it keeps getting rejected with no reason given. How do I fix this?
Uploaded my ID three times for verification and it keeps getting rejected with no explanation of what's wrong with the photo.
Refund for a canceled order never came through even though the merchant confirmed it on their end. Support said to 'wait 5-7 business days' two weeks ago.
Wish the fee was shown before I hit confirm instead of after the money is already sent.
Why do I need this much documentation: Just to increase my weekly send limit I was asked for a selfie, ID, and a utility bill. Seems excessive for a $300 increase.
The identity verification process wanted a selfie, a government ID, AND a proof of address just to raise my sending limit by $200. Way too much friction.
Customer support chat felt like talking to a wall. Took forever to get a real answer.
Linking my Chase debit card fails every single time with a generic error code. Works fine in every other app I use.
Debit card won't link: Every time I try to add my bank debit card I get error code 4021. I've tried three different cards and none work.
Direct deposit didn't show up on payday even though my employer confirmed it was sent two days early like usual. Had to scramble to cover bills.
App has been crashing a lot lately, especially when I check old transactions.
Instant transfer fee jumped from 1.5% to 1.75% with zero notice. Sneaky way to raise fees on people who need their money fast.
Surprise fee on instant transfer: I was charged a higher fee than usual for an instant transfer and there was no warning it had changed before I confirmed.
Didn't realize there was a fee for adding money with a credit card until after I'd already done it. Should be way more visible before you confirm.
Nothing really, it does exactly what I need for splitting bills with roommates.
Waited on hold for 40 minutes only to get disconnected. Called back and had to explain the entire situation from scratch again.
Still waiting on hold: I've been on hold for over 35 minutes trying to talk to a person about a billing issue. Is there a faster way to reach a human?
Chatted with support about a duplicate charge and they resolved it in under 10 minutes with no hoops to jump through. Genuinely impressed.
There is no phone number anywhere in the app. The only option is a chatbot that just loops the same three unhelpful answers.
A built in way to schedule recurring payments would save me so much time every month.
App keeps crashing on transaction history: Since the latest update the app crashes every single time I open my transaction history tab. Happens on both wifi and cellular.
App crashes every time I try to open my transaction history. Been happening since the last update, completely unusable now.
Constant lag when loading my balance. Sometimes shows the wrong number for a few seconds before it corrects itself, which is terrifying when you're checking if a payment went through.
Dark mode please, and maybe the ability to categorize past transactions.
Balance shows wrong amount briefly: When I open the app my balance flashes an incorrect number for a couple seconds before updating to the right one. Kind of alarming.
The redesign is clean and I can actually find my transaction history now without digging through five menus. Nice work.
Overall pretty happy, the redesign made things easier to find.
The navigation is so confusing. I still can't figure out where to find my routing and account number without searching online.
Feature request: recurring payments: Could you add a way to schedule a payment to repeat every month automatically? I send rent to the same person every time manually.
Please add a dark mode, my eyes would thank you. Otherwise the app does what I need it to do.
Would love a way to schedule recurring payments to the same person every month instead of manually sending it each time.
It's fine I guess. Nothing special but nothing broken either. Does what a payments app needs to do.
Been using this for two years to split rent with roommates and it has never once given me trouble. Does exactly what it says on the tin.
Got a suspicious text claiming to be you asking to confirm my card. Might want to warn users about that scam.
Thinking about closing my account: Between the frozen funds and the hold times I'm seriously considering moving to a different app. This is the third issue this month.
Considering switching to a competitor after this account freeze nonsense. Two weeks with my money locked up is unacceptable for a company this size.
